items.title: Bill Dobbins interviewed by Monk Rowe, Rochester, New York, January 11, 2012
items.q: it was somebody like Seymour Hersh or — well anyway — they mentioned that during the time before the Soviet Union fell that they were in Czechoslovakia

ctx.x: Were you on campus the day that massacre occurred?

I was yeah. I wasn’t actually there in the area where the people were shot but it wasn’t all that far from the music building. And I can remember being there and hearing the gunfire. It was a terrible time. But it reminds me, I can’t remember the exact person who said this, but it was one of the few real investigative reporters. It was somebody like Seymour Hersh or — well anyway — they mentioned that during the time before the Soviet Union fell that they were in Czechoslovakia and there happened to be a time…
How do you encourage your students to be proactive?
